method: Fresh independent source regression review of baseline..a510661, recorded gates and browser result provenance. Current system Chromium keyboard/workflow reruns listed separately. No visual score assigned and no app source edited.

sharedDefaults.ProductCombobox: posKeyboardSafety=false, localizeMetadata=false; POS opts in only
sharedDefaults.Dialog: closeLabel optional; original close button retained without opt-in
sharedDefaults.TransactionReviewDialog: amountLanguage/closeLabel optional; original amount default retained

businessReview: No calculator, ledger/stock store, installment domain or settings/navigation source changed.
Stock/serial eligibility and onSave/onResolve logic preserved; changes bind labels/errors and translate displayed text.
Payment method/account values, source invoice identity, quantity factors, selected-unit prices, completion/receipt callbacks preserved.
DateLabel is read-only display using original invoice date for edit and Dhaka businessToday for new/duplicate; no stored date changed.
POS CSS remains scoped to sale cart/POS screen; no shell restyle. Vendor lint exclusion is pinned upstream runtime only, not authored source.

freshReruns.sandboxNote: Initial attempts failed before launch with setsockopt denied; successful reruns use approved execution outside the restricted sandbox.

remainingIssues.detail: Manual installment collection allocation/date validation messages remain English in Bangla. c4-audit.json verifies exact paths; not a changed business rule.
POS does not wire an on-picker missing-product creation path; no new workflow invented.
Fresh final design review confirms supported dense three/four-unit 1440px states need local horizontal scrolling to reach totals/remove; routine desktop fit is fixed.
Dense desktop selected unit shows P… instead of full short symbol; see independent c4-design.

limitations: Browser preview outcomes only; no real backend, bank, stock or ledger posting verified.
No physical print/browser print dialog, physical device/IME or exhaustive WCAG/zoom/on-screen-keyboard certification.
This regression reviewer did not independently rerun all five gates or all fourteen browser suites; stored logs/results are attributed evidence.
result: No verified new business/shared-default regression in reviewed diff; fresh keyboard and 96 workflow journeys passed. Independent visual remaining issues are disclosed separately.
